title: Lifecycle security and privacy roles and risk reviews need operating evidence
remediation: The sponsor system owner and development lead identify the lifecycle stages, accountable people and review gates for each assessed component or service. Trace a selected requirement and risk from acquisition or design through testing and release, with owners, dated approvals and a follow-up disposition.

milestones.title: Collect the approved lifecycle and named role assignments, a security and privacy requirement trace, and a dated lifecycle risk decision
